subject: Intro & mutual-plan handshake — technical kickoff and evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <amonroe@atlasml.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & mutual-plan handshake — technical kickoff and evaluation timeline

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time last week. I wanted to start a brief thread to align on a mutual action plan (MAP) and get the right technical and procurement folks on our kickoff.

Introducing the folks from our side:
- Neha Kapoor — Solutions Engineer (technical lead for the evaluation).
- Marcus Lin — ML Engineer (model/quality point-of-contact).
- Jasmine Liu — Customer Success / AM (contract & onboarding).

Neha and Marcus, meet Alex, AtlasML's engineering lead. Alex — can you confirm who from your engineering org will join the technical kickoff (names/emails) and whether your security/procurement folks should be looped now or later?

What I propose:
- Week 0 (this week): Align on stakeholders, environment access, and evaluation acceptance criteria.
- Week 1: Technical kickoff (30–45m) — env access, sample data, success metrics.
- Weeks 2–5: Evaluation run (we'll provide a MAP with milestones and a token budget).
- Target close: 6 weeks from kickoff (we can compress if procurement moves faster).

Attached is a first-pass MAP draft (MAP-draft-20270412.pdf) with suggested milestones and roles. Please review and share any edits; we'll lock it at the kickoff.

For the technical kickoff, are you available for a 30-min session on Wed 14 Apr at 10:00 AM ET / 07:00 AM PT? If that time doesn't work, propose two other slots and Neha will confirm.

Next asks:
- Alex: confirm engineering attendees + security contact.
- AtlasML: provide a small sample dataset and a tech contact to create temporary evaluation credentials (VPN/SSH/API).

Looking forward — thanks all.

Best,
Sojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-draft-20270412.pdf (3 pages)

Subject: Re: Intro & mutual-plan handshake — technical kickoff and evaluation timeline

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear plan and the draft MAP. I looped in two folks from Atlas engineering and procurement:
- Priya Singh (Engineering Lead, priya.singh@atlasml.com) — she'll own the evaluation on our side.
- Emma Chen (Procurement, emma.chen@atlasml.com) — will handle the contracting cadence.

Wed 14 Apr at 10:00 AM ET works for us. Please send a short agenda and calendar invite.

Two quick notes:
1) Priya will need SOC2 and data handling documentation ahead of the kickoff; can you send the security packet (or point us to a secure link)?
2) For the sample dataset: we can share a 2–5GB anonymized subset; Priya will coordinate.

Appreciate the MAP — Priya and I will review and come with any edits.

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & mutual-plan handshake — technical kickoff and evaluation timeline

Hi Alex / Priya — great to meet you both. I'm looking forward to the kickoff on Wed 14 Apr at 10:00 AM ET. Below is a short agenda and a list of items we'll need before or during the session.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 0–5m: Introductions & success criteria (Priya to confirm acceptance metrics).
- 5–15m: Environment access and data plan (who will create creds / how to share samples).
- 15–25m: Evaluation run plan & token budget (what we'll measure and how we'll report).
- 25–30m: Next steps & MAP sign-off.

Pre-kickoff checklist (please send or confirm):
- Create a temporary API user or allowlist IP for our evaluation (username + expiration).
- Share an anonymized sample dataset (2–5GB recommended) or a small synthetic sample if data cannot be shared.
- Confirm security contact for SOC2 packet (we'll upload to the Drive link below).

Technical notes / acceptance criteria suggestions:
- Latency target: p95 < 450ms for 256-token requests on the test workload.
- Throughput: can you share expected concurrent requests? We'll recommend batching settings accordingly.
- Quality: please provide 4–6 example prompts and the business metric (e.g., summary F1, QA accuracy).

I've uploaded an environment checklist (env-checklist.txt) and a link to the MAP in a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-AtlasML-MAP

Marcus — quick note: once Priya shares the sample, can you validate tokenization and quantization expectations?

See you on Wed.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Great — appreciate the quick responses. We'll send a calendar invite for Wed 14 Apr 10:00 AM ET with Neha as the host.

Emma, looping you for procurement: our standard evaluation MAP and billing terms are attached in the Drive link. For transparency, we're tracking this as deal RDW-2027-ATL-3421 with a target close date of 2027-05-24. If procurement needs a different cadence (faster close or internal PO), let us know and Jasmine will coordinate.

Action items captured:
- Soojin: send calendar invite and MAP link (in progress).
- Neha: lead technical kickoff and share env checklist (done).
- Priya/Alex: provide sample dataset and confirm security contact.
- Emma: confirm billing contact and preferred contract turnaround (DocuSign link enclosed).

Thanks all — see you Wed.
